good: Strong speed cues: speed lines, blur and an FOV kick on boost up to 280 km/h
Bold animated TAKEDOWN! card and NEAR MISS + BOOST pops, with a full Burnout-style HUD
Varied track: a night-lit city canyon and a coastal cliff stretch with bends
bad: Holding only gas scrapes the wall through bends for a long time, and the car often flies off the road into water or sand and crashes
Free play sits stuck in 8th, so the rivals pull away fast once you make mistakes
Low-poly blocky art, with a dark slab cliff and flat sand that look unfinished
opus-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It feels fast and the takedowns pop like Burnout, but the car keeps grinding the barriers and falling off the cliff road.

good: Strong sense of speed: blur, speed lines and a city canyon with lit windows
Clear Burnout-style HUD with a boost bar that turns cyan and a big TAKEDOWN! card
Drift smoke and skid marks, and a scenic sunset coastline with hills and trees
bad: Holding only W has the car riding the wall through the bends, and crashes into the water are common and look odd
Low-poly box cars and flat terrain make it look cheap, and the player drops to 8th and stays there
The takedown only shows in the trailer, and the crash view of the car upside-down on the water looks broken
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks good at speed with the city and sunset and a punchy takedown card, but it is rough to drive: I scrape the wall, fall into the water, and the cars look blocky.
